application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 Horse Chestnut: Reduce crown by approximately 25% overall, removing approximately 2m from the height and width while maintaining a balanced and natural crown profile.
Existing height: approximately 10m
Finished height: approximately 7.5m
Existing width: approximately 7m
Finished width: approximately 5m
Justification: Routine maintenance to manage crown size and maintain the tree in a suitable, balanced condition.


T2 Holm Oak: Reduce crown by approximately 25% overall, reducing approximately 1.9m from the height and 1.3m from the radial crown spread, ensuring a balanced and natural crown profile is maintained.
Existing height: approximately 7.5m
Finished height: approximately 5.6m
Existing width: approximately 5.25m
Finished width: approximately 3.9m
Justification: To reduce suppression within the multi-stemmed crown and improve the overall shape, balance and structural form of the tree.
